Id: # Stage timeline beats (Nov 9 2026 missions). A mission is one stage in 3 acts; objectives come from Missions.csv (Objectives) and the
# stage's minibosses from Missions.csv (Minibosses / MinibossAt). This file adds the swarm waves inside each act and the Final Swarm tiers.
# Kind Swarm: At = share of the ACT (0..1). A burst of Count x Enemy (x team size and Difficulty) around the reapers
# Kind Miniboss: At = share of the act. An extra named miniboss (HealthMult / DamageMult on its normal stats); FreeChest 1 = a free chest each.
# Kind FinalSwarm: At = minutes into overtime (the stage clock ran out before the boss was summoned). Count = extra spawns per second (solo

Kind: grows by Tuning FinalSwarmRampPerMinute. HealthMult / DamageMult on top of Tuning FinalSwarmHealthPerMinute / DamagePerMinute.

At: 3+ = act 3 (and overtime). Missions: * or a '|' list of Missions.csv ids.
